positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented new gameplay mechanics using Verse within Unreal Editor for Fortnite, driving a user engagement of over 15 million hours within a single year.
• Developed a versatile Discord bot in Python capable of recording voice communications across multiple servers and performing audio transcoding, optimizing performance through multi-threading techniques.
• Utilized GitHub Actions to automate and streamline the build and deployment processes of containers to Google Compute Engine from Google Artifact Registry, increasing efficiency and reliability in software delivery.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a cutting-edge League of Legends analytics platform, integrating a TypeScript-based data pipeline and React user interface for over 50 million gameplay events.
• Managed the deployment and orchestration of diverse AWS resources including EC2, RDS, CloudFront, and Cognito, ensuring seamless operation of critical applications.
• Spearheaded a computer vision project to extract valuable insights from broadcasted Call of Duty streams using OpenCV and Python, enhancing data accessibility and strategic decision-making.
• Engineered and launched a scalable NFT API integrated with various Web3 services, ensuring efficient token minting for a user base of approximately 20000 individuals.
• Designed and implemented new gameplay mechanics using Verse within Unreal Editor for Fortnite, driving a user engagement of over 1 million hours within a single year.

positions.title: Software Developer/Data Scientist
positions.description:
• Developed a robust data processing backend in Java and Python capable of processing up to several terabytes of data per week.
• Simplified data analysis by creating tailored data visualization dashboards with React.
• Improved I/O operations during builds which decreased overall build times by 50% and saved 30+ hours per week across the entire team.
• Created GitLab CI/CD pipelines to automate builds, tests, code coverage, code quality, and vulnerability scans.
• Migrated and automated website deployments from OpenShift to Kubernetes using Rancher and Helm.

positions.title: Software Developer/Data Scientist
positions.description:
• Developed containers for deploying an image analysis tool and Visual Studio Code via Kubernetes for approximately 1000 personnel.
• Implemented tasks queues in Celery to handle and distribute image analysis jobs which increased processing speeds by 400%.
• Evaluated clustering algorithms for accuracy and efficiency on datasets containing more than 1 billion feature vectors.
• Performed largescale image analysis by distributing workloads across a compute cluster managed with Univa Grid Engine.

positions.title: Software Developer/System Administrator
positions.description:
• Developed an Angular frontend and a Spring backend for a service providing on-demand, compliant cloud environments for data analysis to approximately 2000 personnel.
• Automated administration of infrastructure through Jenkins CI/CD, Puppet and Ansible for approximately 4000 Linux servers.
• Corrected erroneous EC2 requests which reduced wastage of compute resources by 33%.
• Improved efficiency of data caching and querying which resulted in a 1000x increase in processing speed and 25x decrease in memory usage.

positions.title: Data Scientist/Applied Research Mathematician
positions.description:
• Researched various implementations of public key infrastructure (PKI) object generation and documented differences between libraries.
• Implemented PKI object classification through random forests and partial match prediction.
• Streamlined data processing via Perl and Python which saved 4+ hours per week.

positions.title: Supplemental Instructor
positions.description: Provided in-class guidance to calculus students as well as leading an out-of-class instructional session.

positions.title: Physics Tutor
positions.description: Tutored individuals in both algebra-based and calculus-based physics courses.

positions.title: Mathematics Tutor
positions.description: Tutored individuals in a multitude of mathematics courses such as calculus, discrete mathematics, and statistics.

positions.title: AMALTHEA REU Student Researcher
positions.description: Researched and implemented statistical analysis techniques to both finite-dimensional and functional data.
